job.job_description:
Job Summary
Join our team at Alegeus, where youll experience unmatched opportunity and a culture that cares deeply about succeeding together. As an Engineer, LLM Ops, youll play a critical role in enabling governed, scalable, and high-quality AI adoptiondriving how LLM-powered solutions are deployed, monitored, and continuously improved across the enterprise. Collaborate with dedicated colleagues, embrace a spirit of innovation, and build an enriching career with us.
Opportunity Happens Here Realize Yours
Alongside the best and the brightest, you will regularly:
Shape the future of AI operations by building and evolving LLMOps practices that drive reliable, secure, and scalable deployment of AI-powered solutions.
Lead the operational excellence of generative AI by managing prompt lifecycles, model configurations, and evaluation workflows that ensure consistent, high-quality outcomes.
Drive innovation with responsible AI rollout strategies, leveraging A/B testing, feature flags, and human-in-the-loop processes to safely bring new capabilities to production.
Elevate AI performance and quality through advanced monitoring, evaluation frameworks, and continuous feedback loops that improve accuracy, cost-efficiency, and user experience.
Champion governed AI adoption by embedding auditability, traceability, and compliance into every stage of the LLM lifecycle.
Collaborate cross-functionally with AI engineers, data scientists, platform teams, and business stakeholders to transform cutting-edge AI prototypes into production-ready solutions.
Essential Skills for Creating a Lasting Impact
Alegeus colleagues are known as problem-solvers, risk-takers, and innovative thinkers. As an Engineer, LLM Ops, these skills are essential for success:
Abilities: Strong problem-solving and collaboration skills with the ability to operationalize LLMOps practicesincluding prompt lifecycle management, evaluation, observability, governance, and secure AI deploymentacross cross-functional teams.
Experience: 3+ years in LLMOps, AI operations, software engineering, DevOps, cloud engineering, MLOps, or related roles, with hands-on exposure to generative AI (LLMs, prompts, RAG, embeddings) and experience with Azure OpenAI or similar platforms, CI/CD tools (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions), and programming in Python or C#/.NET.
Education: Bachelors degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., computer science, engineering, or related discipline).
Location: Bangalore, India
